segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ גֵּט מְעוּשֶּׂה, בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל – כָּשֵׁר, וּבְגוֹיִם – פָּסוּל. וּבְגוֹיִם – חוֹבְטִין אוֹתוֹ וְאוֹמְרִים לוֹ: ״עֲשֵׂה מַה שֶּׁיִּשְׂרָאֵל אוֹמְרִים לָךְ״ (וְכָשֵׁר).
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a bill of divorce» that the husband «was compelled» by the court to write and give his wife, if he was compelled «by a Jewish» court it is «valid, but» if he was compelled «by gentiles» it is «invalid. But with regard to gentiles they may beat him» at the request of the Jewish court «and say to him: Do what the Jews are telling you, and it is a valid» divorce.

moves.summary: Coerced get: by Jews valid, by gentiles invalid, gentiles acting for a Jewish court valid.

positions.claim: a get coerced by Jews is valid, by gentiles invalid; gentiles may beat him to do what the Jews say
